title: Engine determinism CONFIRMED + H_301 silent bug IDENTIFIED — rule 60 n=5 st=21 cap=4 = 16.5 (H_297 was correct, H_301's 18.5 was sort_asc-in-place artifact)
question: Is eca_tpm × big_phi_bounded deterministic? Where does H_297's 16.5 (rule 60 n=5 st=21 cap=4) come from given H_301 measured 18.5?
engine: HEXAD/IIT4/lib + stdlib iit4_bounded — diagnostic 20-call probe (no new measurement code, just instrumentation)
runtime: $0 mac-local · hexa-only · LLM none · NO GPU · ~30s wall

findings.F302_1_REPRO_INTRA: PASS — rule 60 n=5 st=21 cap=4 called twice both = 16.5 (engine intra-process deterministic)
findings.F302_2_ORDER_INDEP: PASS — panel A [rule 60 → rule 90] gives rule 60 = 16.5; panel B [rule 90 → rule 60] also gives rule 60 = 16.5 (no shared mutable state between rule calls)
findings.F302_3_RULE_90_INT: PASS — rule 90 n=5 st=21 cap=4 = 19.5 (cross-H gold standard with H_297/H_300 reproduced exactly)
findings.F302_4_RULE_60_CURRENT_H301: FAIL (in the right direction) — H_301's 18.5 NOT reproduced; true value at (rule=60, n=5, st=21, cap=4) = 16.5, matching H_297 exactly. H_301's reported 18.5 was a bug, not the engine.
findings.F302_5_LOC_16_5: PASS — 16.5 found at n=5 st=21 cap=4 (exactly the H_297-reported location). H_297's 16.5 IS the true value; no artifact / different state needed.

checks: 5 PASS / 1 FAIL — verdict 🟢 SUPPORTED-NUMERICAL: engine deterministic, H_297 16.5 verified, H_301 18.5 = sort_asc-in-place bug exposed
verdict_class: 🟢 SUPPORTED-NUMERICAL — F302.1/2/3/5/6 PASS confirm engine determinism + H_297 reproducibility. F302.4 FAIL exposes the silent bug in H_301 (and latent in H_300, but masked by rule 90's 3-distinct-value plateau).

h301_bug_root_cause.symptom: H_301 reported rule 60 n=5 st=21 cap=4 = 18.5, but true value is 16.5
h301_bug_root_cause.root_cause: sort_asc(values) in H_301 (and H_300) mutates the `values` array IN PLACE (hexa-lang `let mut out = arr` is reference-alias, not deep copy). After `let sorted = sort_asc(values)`, the subsequent `values[21]` read returns sorted[21], NOT the original st=21 measurement.
h301_bug_root_cause.why_h300_masked: rule 90 at n=5 cap=4 has only 3 distinct values {19, 19.5, 27.5} with multiplicities (8, 16, 8). Sorted positions 8..23 are all 19.5 — so sorted[21] = 19.5 = true rule90.st=21 (by coincidence of distribution shape). H_300 reported correctly only because of this coincidence.
h301_bug_root_cause.why_h301_exposed: rule 60 has 6 distinct values, rule 30 has 29, rule 110 has 32. sorted[21] ≠ values[21] for any of these. H_301's reported `st=21 (alt)` values for rule 60/110/30 were ALL sorted[21] (i.e. roughly p65), not the true st=21 measurements.
h301_bug_root_cause.scope_of_invalidation: H_301's individual `st=21 (alt)` values for rule 60/110/30 are CORRUPTED. The rule-90 case in H_300 happened to give correct value by coincidence. ALL OTHER H_301 statistics (min/p25/median/p75/max/mean, count Phi>1, distinct-value count) use the sorted array directly and ARE VALID. The F301.4-6 PASS verdict ('alt-state in [p25, p75]') was a tautology because sorted[21] is by definition between sorted[8] and sorted[24].
h301_bug_root_cause.fix: In future H, either (a) deep-copy before sort: `let sorted = sort_asc(copy_array(values))`, OR (b) avoid touching `values` after sort: keep a separate `st21_val = values[21]` snapshot BEFORE calling sort_asc. The bug is a hexa-lang reference-aliasing gotcha that warrants a hexa-lang inbox patch note.

L2: hexa-lang reference-aliasing semantics (let mut out = arr aliases instead of copying) is a language-level gotcha; H_302 only documents the symptom — full hexa-lang ownership/copy semantics 정밀 spec 는 hexa-lang repo issue 후보.
L3: stdlib stdlib/consciousness/iit4_bounded version 변동은 점검 안 함 (cross-H rule-60 가 같은 16.5 reproduce 했으므로 변동 가능성 낮음 but not certain).
L4: ECA proxy + toy substrate — diagnostic H 도 같은 scope.

L5: H_300's reported st=21 = 19.5 was coincidentally correct (rule 90's 3-plateau). 다른 N 에서 rule 90 도 같은 coincidence 보장은 없음 — H_300 의 result.json st=21 보고도 sorted[21]일 가능성이지만 rule 90의 lattice-symmetry 가 silent-mask 했을 가능성 ↑.

H_301 distribution statistics (min/p25/median/p75/max/mean, count above 1, distinct-value count) all remain VALID because they read the sorted array directly. The rule-signature finding (distinct count = 3/6/29/32 across rules 90/60/30/110) is uncontaminated. Verdict 🟢 SUPPORTED-NUMERICAL — deterministic toy-substrate diagnosis.
